name: Curse of Phantom Putrescence
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [fear, mind-affecting, curse]; Level bard 3, lathspell 2, mesmerist 3, psychic 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round + 1d10 minutes
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This cursed illusion causes the subject to believe their flesh is rotting and falling off their body, and that their internal organs are spilling out. If the target fails their saving throw, they are dazed with horror for 1 round. On the following round, if they fail a second saving throw, they fall unconscious for 1d10 minutes, during which time they cannot be roused normally. This illusion cannot be removed by dispel magic. It requires a remove curse or break enchantment. A true seeing spell can see the curse as merely an illusion.
